# CleanApp

> CleanApp helps people report physical and digital problems with text and optional images. AI-assisted analysis structures observations, connects related reports and helps identify relevant brands, places and recipients. The public product includes maps and report views; organization plans provide additional ways to work with relevant reports.

This file is a navigation aid. Use the linked pages for current product information and terms. The reporting receipt shows available submission and processing status.

## Start reporting
- [Report a problem](https://www.cleanapp.io/report-a-problem): browser reporting for a physical or digital observation
- [Report a pothole](https://www.cleanapp.io/report-a-pothole): road location, direction and visible damage
- [Report illegal dumping](https://www.cleanapp.io/report-illegal-dumping): waste location, extent and observed context
- [Report a broken website](https://www.cleanapp.io/report-a-website-problem): affected service, screenshot and expected versus actual result
- [Report an accessibility barrier](https://www.cleanapp.io/report-an-accessibility-barrier): physical and digital barriers and their practical impact
